import React from 'react'; import { TSPComparison } from '../types'; interface Props { comparison: TSPComparison | null; } const TSPComparisonPanel: React.FC = ({ comparison }) => { if (!comparison) { return (

TSP Algorithm Comparison

Run route optimization to see TSP comparison

); } const { exact, approximate, distanceDifference, timeDifference, distanceError, timeError } = comparison; return (

TSP Algorithm Comparison

{/* Exact TSP */}
Exact (Brute Force)
Route: {exact.route.join(' → ')}
Total Distance: {exact.totalDistance.toFixed(2)} km
Total Time: {exact.totalTime.toFixed(2)} min
Execution Time: {exact.executionTime.toFixed(3)} ms
Nodes Explored: {exact.nodesExplored}
Complexity: O(n!)
{/* Approximate TSP */}
Nearest Neighbor
Route: {approximate.route.join(' → ')}
Total Distance: {approximate.totalDistance.toFixed(2)} km
Total Time: {approximate.totalTime.toFixed(2)} min
Execution Time: {approximate.executionTime.toFixed(3)} ms
Nodes Explored: {approximate.nodesExplored}
Complexity: O(n²)
{/* Comparison Metrics */}

Comparison Analysis

Distance Difference: 0 ? 'positive' : 'neutral'}`}> {distanceDifference > 0 ? '+' : ''}{distanceDifference.toFixed(2)} km
Time Difference: 0 ? 'positive' : 'neutral'}`}> {timeDifference > 0 ? '+' : ''}{timeDifference.toFixed(2)} min
Distance Error: 5 ? 'warning' : 'good'}`}> {distanceError.toFixed(2)}%
Time Error: 5 ? 'warning' : 'good'}`}> {timeError.toFixed(2)}%
Speedup: {(exact.executionTime / approximate.executionTime).toFixed(2)}x faster
Quality: {comparison.exactOptimal ? 'Near Optimal' : 'Suboptimal'}
); }; export default TSPComparisonPanel;
